mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_ontology (dataset_id, ontology_id, bound_by, bound_at) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{ontologyId}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, dataset_id) DO UPDATE SET ontology_id = EXCLUDED.ontology_id, bound_by = EXCLUDED.bound_by, bound_at = EXCLUDED.bound_at
mapper.update: MERGE INTO dataset_ontology t USING (SELECT #{datasetId} AS d FROM DUAL) s ON (t.dataset_id = s.d) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.ontology_id = #{ontologyId}, t.bound_by = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, t.bound_at = WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (dataset_id, ontology_id, bound_by, bound_at) VALUES (s.d, #{ontologyId}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, )
mapper.select: SELECT dn.ontology_id FROM dataset_ontology dn WHERE dn.dataset_id = #{datasetId}
